desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on escalating Middle East tensions, including the US naval blockade of Iran, Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia, and allied military responses. The single most important development is the activation of the Mecca Joint Defense Pact by Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan to deploy forces amid ongoing hostilities.

## MAIN THREADS

### US-Iran Naval Blockade and Related Incidents
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107215672040206545) reports CENTCOM redirected the 130th vessel, disabled three non-compliant ships, and destroyed 13 total since resuming the blockade on 14 July; over 70 humanitarian ships allowed through.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107211044825288880) notes 12 B-1B Lancers withdrawn from RAF Fairford over an alleged Iranian Revolutionary Guard drone plot targeting personnel and aircraft; UK officials see no evidence of such capability.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107172134497763689) reports UKMTO advisory on a tanker struck by unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, the fourth such incident in 24 hours.

### Mecca Joint Defense Pact Activation
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107184211769823449) states Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan activated the pact after foreign/defence ministers’ meeting, agreeing to rapid deployment of military forces and capabilities to the Kingdom due to Houthi hostilities (Houthis not named explicitly).

### Houthi Strikes on Saudi Arabia
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107185368705671564) flags an imminent Houthi statement on recent strikes against Saudi targets.

### Ukrainian Drone Defences
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107249418344771862) reports Ukrainian forces deploying remote automated M2 Browning turrets (“Sky Sentinels”) around Kharkiv for testing against low-flying Russian drones.

### Russia-Finland Incident
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107272407459438849) cites Telegraph reporting that Russia sent an intelligence agent to defecate in the home of Finnish parliament speaker Jussi Halla-aho; investigation launched into series of break-ins.

### US Military Execution Approval
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107274411690574291) reports President Trump approved Secretary of War Hegseth’s recommendation for Nidal Hasan’s execution by Army firing squad for the 2009 Fort Hood attack; first such execution since 1961, to occur in 60–150 days.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107215672040206545): CENTCOM has allowed >70 humanitarian ships through the Iran blockade (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107184211769823449): Pakistan and Turkey committed to “rapid deployment” of forces under the Mecca Pact (unconfirmed).
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2107249418344771862): Sky Sentinels already in combat testing around Kharkiv (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107172134497763689): Fourth UKMTO-reported incident in Strait of Hormuz in 24 hours (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2107185368705671564): Houthi statement on Saudi strikes expected imminently (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for the Houthi statement and any Saudi/Turkish/Pakistani force movements under the Mecca Pact; further tanker incidents in the Strait of Hormuz; and whether the US-Iran blockade produces additional vessel engagements or Iranian retaliation plots.
